items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Will Be ‘Worth More Than the Rest of Earth,’ Musk Says. How He Gets There.
items.summary_cn: Musk 公开宣称 SpaceX 价值将超过'地球上其他所有公司总和'，强力看多 SpaceX。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk sets timeline for SpaceX to launch orbital data centers, moon base
items.summary_cn: Musk 给出 SpaceX 发射轨道数据中心和月球基地的时间表，强化 SpaceX 长期叙事，看多信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s plans to colonize space launches this year, and Tesla robots will be the first residents
items.summary_cn: Musk 重提 SpaceX 太空殖民与 Tesla 机器人居民计划，强化 Musk 系（SpaceX/Tesla）长期想象空间。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Thank you to the brilliant and highly respected Gwynne Shotwell, and her husband, Robert, for their extreme Generosity in helping children to attain the ever magnificent American Dream! Their Gift of 325 Million Dollars of SpaceX Stock is greatly appreciated by all. Thousands of children have just been given a better life. Thank you Gwynne and Robert, and continued Great Success! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump 公开感谢 SpaceX 总裁 Gwynne Shotwell 捐赠 3.25 亿美元 SpaceX 股票做慈善，对 SpaceX 间接背书。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Don’t want to invest in Elon Musk? Two new ETFs explicitly exclude him
items.summary_cn: 报道新发 ETF 明确排除 Musk 相关资产，反映市场存在'去Musk化'资金分流，间接影响 SpaceX 估值定价。

items.author: Musk
items.text: This ETF firm is giving investors a way to avoid Elon Musk
items.summary_cn: ETF 公司推出规避 Musk 敞口的产品，反映 Musk 系资产溢价过高存在资金外流风险，间接利空 SpaceX。
